multiples.label: Multiples-Based
multiples.note: P/E, P/S, EV/EBIT etc. vs peers/history · -1.9%

valuation.methodology: AlphaSpread DCF — 15-year forecast via Net Income, Revenue Growth 15.2% (vs 5Y hist 27.3%, Wall St 3Y 24.1%), Net Margin 15.5%→16.8% (vs 5Y 18.3%), Discount Rate 10.5% (WACC/Cost of Equity), Exit Multiple 36.4x P/E. Multiples-Based Value from P/S, P/E, P/OCF, P/B, EV/Sales/EBITDA/EBIT etc. vs peers/history. Intrinsic Value = AlphaSpread selected method (DCF primary for Max). Backtest: VIC 0.32, Quintile Spread 28.3%, Hit Rate 65.1% — systematically informative.

local_crosscheck.note: Local screener cross-check: FY26E P/E ~55x, P/B ~37x, EV/EBITDA ~29x — AlphaSpread DCF still implies 40% upside; Multiples suggests fairly valued vs history.

trends.title: Brownfield ramp without ARPOB dilution
trends.body: Dwarka 235 beds 73% occ in 6M, breakeven; Lucknow +102% EBITDA, Nagpur +86% YoY — ~5,200 beds, 22 hospitals, occupancy 75% (+300 bps).

trends.title: Diagnostics + @Home flywheel
trends.body: Max Lab 300+ centres, 6 labs + @Home + partnerships — non-captive patients, 9% international (14 countries).

trends.title: Payer mix discipline
trends.body: Self-pay + TPA ~66% vs institutional 34%→lower (institutional ~30% below other channels) — protects ARPOB.

trends.title: EBITDA 28.5% with new beds
trends.body: Sales ₹8,712 Cr TTM (+16%), EBITDA ₹2,318 Cr (27% OPM), PAT ₹1,457 Cr (16.8% margin) — stable despite Dwarka/Lucknow additions.

trends.title: Capital discipline at premium
trends.body: ROCE 15.35%, ROE 14.33%, D/E 0.27, Net Debt/EBITDA <1x — growth via brownfield, not leverage.

big_messages.label: Clinical

big_messages.label: Expansion
big_messages.text: “Dwarka breakeven in 6M, Lucknow/Nagpur double-digit EBITDA growth — brownfield first, greenfield selective.”

big_messages.label: Efficiency

flags.evidence: P/E 69.8x (TTM) / 55x FY26E, P/B 11.4x, EV/EBITDA ~32x — premium to hospitals (Apollo ~40x) and to AlphaSpread Multiples fair value (1,026 vs 1,046)
75% occ (+300 bps) — further ramp from Dwarka/Lucknow/Noida needs 70%+ to hold 28.5% EBITDA; ARPOB flat ₹77,100
22 hospitals → greenfield/brownfield capex — D/E 0.27 low but bed adds dilute ROCE if ARPOB/occupancy slip
Institutional share cut to ~34% — watch self-pay/TPA vs international 9% (high realisation) mix
Price caps, clinical regulation — CGHS/PMJAY pricing risk; Max low exposure but sector-wide

bottom_line.core_idea: Not a hospital — quinary care platform (cardiac/onco/neuro/transplant) with asset-light diagnostics + @Home.
bottom_line.what_changed: Single hospital → 22 hospitals, 5,200 beds — occupancy 75% + ARPOB ₹77,100 + 28.5% EBITDA with new beds.
bottom_line.hidden_insight: Watch occupancy × ARPOB — Dwarka 73% in 6M proves ramp, but holds premium multiple.
bottom_line.what_breaks: OCC <70% or ARPOB <75k with new beds → EBITDA <26% → P/E 70x compresses.
bottom_line.open_question: Hold 75% occ + 27% OPM while adding beds and keep ROCE 15%+?
bottom_line.takeaway: Don't pay 70x for beds — own clinical, wait price near AlphaSpread buy zone ₹1,179.

forecast.note: Shares flat at ~97.33 Cr (FV ₹10) — D/E 0.27 gives headroom, no dilution assumed. Bear = occupancy <70% + ARPOB slip + derate to 28x. Base = AlphaSpread DCF (15.2% Rev, 16.8% margin, 10.5%, 36.4x) → ₹1,474 (+7.1% CAGR, +40.9% upside). Bull = payer mix intact + diagnostics flywheel, P/E held at 45x. Current P/E 69.8x; base derates to 36.4x — earnings must do work.

takeaway: Max Healthcare doesn't sell beds — it sells clinical trust where failure is not an option, and filings + AlphaSpread say the next chapter is brownfield 5,200 beds + diagnostics flywheel at 75% occ + ARPOB ₹77,100 — DCF ₹1,465 (+40%) vs Multiples ₹1,026 (fair) → Intrinsic ₹1,474 — fairly valued to 29% undervalued vs buy zone ₹1,179.
